instruction: Look at blank_seed.dxf. Start from the blank seed. Draw a circular flange centered at (80,80) with outer radius 60 on layer OUTLINE and inner radius 25 on layer CUTOUT. Add six diameter 8 bolt holes on radius 45 at 90-degree start, equally spaced every 60 degrees, on layer HOLE. Add text ACAD-06 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
